# llmdoc

> Detached engineering knowledge base for codebases. llmdoc keeps architecture, constraints, rationale, contracts, non-obvious failures, and risky workflows in an independent Knowledge Git repository, while the source repository stays read-only.

Canonical site: https://llmdoc.tokenroll.ai/
Repository: https://github.com/vegetablebird6/llmdoc

## CLI

Treat llmdoc as external tooling. Do not add it to the consumer project's package.json or lockfile.

Create or bind an independent knowledge repository first. The source repository is never modified.

    npx -y @vegetablebird6/llmdoc init --source . --knowledge ../app-knowledge
    npx -y @vegetablebird6/llmdoc bind --source . --knowledge ../app-knowledge

Retrieve task-scoped knowledge from the bound knowledge repository:

    npx -y @vegetablebird6/llmdoc tree
    npx -y @vegetablebird6/llmdoc context --files src/api/client.ts

To inspect the fixed Knowledge HEAD in a browser, start the local-only Viewer. It binds to 127.0.0.1.

    npx -y @vegetablebird6/llmdoc serve

Always use the full scoped package name. A bare npx llmdoc resolves to an unrelated package.

## Machine-readable schemas
